SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_board B WHERE 1 = 1 AND B.DEL_YN = 'n'
AND ( B.BOARD_SJ LIKE '%' || #{searchRequest.keyword} || '%' OR B.BOARD_CN LIKE '%' || #{searchRequest.keyword} || '%' )
AND TRIM(B.DEPT_CD) = TRIM(#{deptCd})
AND B.BOARD_TYPE_CD = #{boardTypeCd}

SELECT B.BOARD_ID ,B.BOARD_TYPE_CD ,B.BOARD_SJ ,B.BOARD_CN ,B.FRST_RGTR_ID ,E.EMP_NM AS empNm ,B.FRST_REG_DT ,B.LAST_MDFR_DT ,B.BOARD_ATCH_FILE_ID ,TRIM(B.DEPT_CD) AS DEPT_CD ,B.PROJ_ID ,B.IMPRTNT_YN ,B.CMNT_USE_YN ,B.VIEW_CNT FROM tb_board B LEFT JOIN TB_EMPLOYEE E ON B.FRST_RGTR_ID = E.EMP_ID WHERE 1 = 1 AND B.DEL_YN = 'n'
AND TRIM(B.DEPT_CD) = TRIM(#{deptCd})
AND B.BOARD_TYPE_CD = #{boardTypeCd}
AND (B.BOARD_SJ LIKE '%'|| #{searchRequest.keyword} || '%' OR B.BOARD_CN LIKE '%'|| #{searchRequest.keyword} || '%')
AND B.DEL_YN = 'n'
ORDER BY B.BOARD_ID DESC OFFSET #{getOffset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{getPageSize} ROWS ONLY

SELECT DISTINCT B.BOARD_TYPE_CD AS boardTypeCd, TRIM(B.DEPT_CD) AS deptCd, CASE WHEN B.BOARD_TYPE_CD = 'FREE' THEN '자유게시판' WHEN B.BOARD_TYPE_CD = 'ANON' THEN '익명게시판' WHEN B.BOARD_TYPE_CD = 'NOTICE' THEN '공지사항' WHEN B.BOARD_TYPE_CD = 'DEPT' THEN D.DEPT_NM
ELSE B.BOARD_SJ END AS boardName FROM tb_board B
LEFT JOIN tb_department D ON TRIM(B.DEPT_CD) = TRIM(D.DEPT_CD) WHERE 1 = 1 AND (
1 = 1
1 = 0
OR B.BOARD_TYPE_CD IN ('FREE', 'ANON', 'NOTICE', 'DEPT') OR B.FRST_RGTR_ID = #{empId} OR TRIM(B.DEPT_CD) = TRIM(#{myDeptCd})
OR TRIM(B.DEPT_CD) IN
#{scopeDeptCd}
)

SELECT B.BOARD_ID ,B.BOARD_TYPE_CD ,B.BOARD_SJ ,B.BOARD_CN ,B.FRST_RGTR_ID ,E.EMP_NM ,B.FRST_REG_DT ,B.LAST_MDFR_DT ,B.BOARD_ATCH_FILE_ID ,B.DEPT_CD ,B.PROJ_ID ,B.IMPRTNT_YN ,B.CMNT_USE_YN ,B.VIEW_CNT FROM tb_board B LEFT JOIN TB_EMPLOYEE E ON B.FRST_RGTR_ID = E.EMP_ID WHERE B.BOARD_ID = #{boardId} AND B.DEL_YN = 'n'

SELECT COMMENT_ID , BOARD_ID , CASE WHEN DEL_YN = 'y' THEN '삭제된 댓글입니다.' ELSE COMMENT_CN END AS COMMENT_CN , WRTER_EMP_ID , WRTE_DT , COMMENT_PRT_ID , COMMENT_DEPTH , COMMENT_ORDER , DEL_YN FROM TB_BOARD_COMMENT WHERE BOARD_ID = #{boardId} START WITH COMMENT_PRT_ID IS NULL CONNECT BY PRIOR COMMENT_ID = COMMENT_PRT_ID ORDER SIBLINGS BY COMMENT_ORDER ASC, COMMENT_ID ASC
SELECT BOARD_ID,EMP_ID,FRST_REG_DT FROM tb_board_like WHERE BOARD_ID = #{boardId} AND EMP_ID = #{empId}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_board WHERE PROJ_ID = #{projId} AND DEL_YN = 'n'
AND ( BOARD_SJ LIKE '%' || #{searchRequest.keyword} || '%' OR BOARD_CN LIKE '%' || #{searchRequest.keyword} || '%' )

SELECT b.BOARD_ID, b.BOARD_TYPE_CD, b.BOARD_SJ, b.BOARD_CN, b.FRST_RGTR_ID, e.EMP_NM AS empNm, b.FRST_REG_DT, b.LAST_MDFR_DT, b.BOARD_ATCH_FILE_ID, b.DEPT_CD, b.IMPRTNT_YN, b.CMNT_USE_YN, b.VIEW_CNT, p.PROJ_ID, p.PROJ_NM, p.PROJ_STAT_CD FROM TB_BOARD b INNER JOIN TB_PROJECT p ON b.PROJ_ID = p.PROJ_ID LEFT JOIN TB_EMPLOYEE e ON b.FRST_RGTR_ID = e.EMP_ID WHERE p.PROJ_ID = #{projId} AND b.DEL_YN = 'n' ORDER BY b.FRST_REG_DT DESC OFFSET #{getOffset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{getPageSize} ROWS ONLY
